questions.stem: Which of the following statements about otosclerosis are correct? Otosclerosis primarily affects the region of the fissula ante fenestram, located anterior to the round window. The bony labyrinth is involved in otosclerosis, but the membranous labyrinth usually remains unaffected. Peri-otic duct is filled with endolymph. Otic capsule ossifies from 2 centers.
